title: stezy.lt is live
summary: STEZY's own corner of the internet: every project gets its own world, and the whole page changes its look as you scroll from one to the next.
A particle STEZY writes itself on the way in, and scatters away from your mouse.

title: Write your own word
summary: At the very end of the page, type anything and the particles write it.
Share the link and it opens with your word, for whoever gets it.

title: See everything
summary: Every cover on one searchable wall. Press / anywhere, or the grid button at the top.

title: Echo
summary: A small light lost in dark caves. Every echo draws the cave in dust for a moment, and tells the things that listen where you are.
Plays right here in your browser, on a computer or a phone.

title: STEZY's picks
summary: A small sparkle marks STEZY's own favourites: on their pages, in the list on the side, and as a filter on the See everything wall.

title: Smoother scrolling
summary: The same look with a lot less work behind it: scrolling from one world to the next is much smoother, especially on slower computers.

title: Every app page comes alive
summary: Each app's name is now made of its own material: a lamp that reveals Nocturne, curtains that part for Veil, ash falling from REAPER, water over Undertow.
Move your mouse around on each one.

title: Visits and downloads
summary: The bottom of the page now shows how many visits and downloads stezy.lt has had, and each app shows how many times it was downloaded.
Counts only: no cookies, nothing personal.

title: Latest
summary: This page. New apps, updates and changes to stezy.lt, newest first, filled in by itself every time something ships.
A dot on the button at the top tells you when there's something you haven't seen.

title: Something’s hidden
summary: Seven shiny things are hiding around stezy.lt. Find all seven and something unlocks.
That’s all we’re saying. Keep your eyes open.

title: The first projects
summary: Ghost Line, Shadow, Phantom, LinkFuse and the Schedule Steve mod: the things STEZY made before this site existed, each with its own world and a download.

title: Night drop
summary: Thirteen small Windows tools in one night, each with its own look: a curtain for your screen, a mic mute with an ON AIR sign, a diary of your screen time and more.

title: A Mobile tab
summary: Phone apps now have their own tab next to Games, Apps and Remixes, so they never get mixed up with the PC ones.
On a computer, an Android app's page shows a code to scan with your phone.
